thread:
mina: hey team — day 1 question :wave: trying to flip a staging feature flag and run a quick canary job but the console shows me as readonly. i also need a short-lived service account to hit staging/infer. who should i ping?

ops-bot: Onboard helper: please complete https://redwood.internal/onboard-access with project id, flag id, and desired ttl for SA keys. If the UI returns 403 it often means auto-grouping hasn't propagated. Ticket INC-52345 created.

charlie: welcome @mina! :tada: what flag and project? i can pre-approve a JIT once groups look good to avoid extra back-and-forth.

mina: flag is `experiment.control_plane.alpha` in project `control-plane-staging`. need SA to run ~2k requests over 20m, 6h ttl fine. tried the form and it failed with 403. attaching a quick screenshot.

charlie: thanks. run `id` in your okta profile to confirm groups. usually new hires miss the `console-operators` or `console-staging-users` group. i'll check provisioning.

ops-bot: Provisioning note: adding mina -> `console-staging-users` queued. Group propagation ~5m.

mina: ok groups show only `engineering`.

charlie: adding you manually now. after propagation hit the JIT form and use a short approval note: "Temp ff-admin to validate experiment.control_plane.alpha (ENG-15890) — 6h"

charlie: also if you want to create a local service account for testing here's an example command (internal):
```bash
redwood-iam create-service-account --alias sa-mina-e2e --roles inference.invoker,logging.writer --ttl 6h --vault-path secret/data/onboard/mina/sa-key
```

mina: group landed, tried the JIT form and it allowed me to request, but the activation step asked for a reviewer. who can approve?

leo: hi mina — i can approve for that staging project. ping me when you submit the JIT activation.

mina: requested JIT with the note you suggested and requested the SA.

leo: approved the JIT activation. window opens in 8 minutes for 6h. i'll also ask devops to create the vaulted SA key.

platform-bot: Audit ticket AUDIT-81234 created for JIT activation and SA issuance. All toggle activity will be linked to this id.

devops (note): SA created and vaulted at `secret/data/onboard/mina/sa-key`. roles: `inference.invoker`, `logging.writer`. TTL 6h. rotation policy applied.

mina: got the vault path and JIT window. flipping the flag and running the canary now. quick question — who owns flag docs/runbook so i can add an experiment link?

charlie: flag metadata lives in infra/feature-flags. open a tiny PR with: id, owner alias, description, runbook link. tag `@platform-flag-owners`. if it's infra-owned i'll shepherd the PR.

mina: perfect, will open the PR after validation and attach AUDIT-81234 to ENG-15890. thanks for the speedy help everyone! :rocket:

ops-bot: Reminder: JIT will auto-expire at the end of the window. If you finish early please deactivate the session to reduce blast radius.
